page_title: UDI 0-1 VER | Udinese v Verona 15/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's the end of the match.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) has tested the patience of referee Giovanni Ayroldi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
88' Paolo Zanetti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Davide Faraoni (Verona) replacing Tomas Suslov.
86' Arthur Atta (Udinese) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
84' Amin Sarr will be replaced by Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona).
84' What a chance! The ball rebounds out to Jordan Zemura (Udinese) and his strike from the edge of the box goes narrowly wide of the right post.
83' Simone Pafundi (Udinese) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
81' Substitution. Lorenzo Lucca walks off the pitch and Keinan Davis (Udinese) comes on as a substitute.
81' Kosta Runjaic decides to make a substitution. Sandi Lovric will be replaced by Simone Pafundi (Udinese).
79' Iker Bravo (Udinese) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
78' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul. Verona are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
77' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 18:12.

72' 0 - 1 Ondrej Duda (Verona) unleashes a beautiful rocket of a shot from a long-range free kick. The ball goes into the top right corner and leaves the goalkeeper beaten. This takes hours and hours on the training ground. The score is 0:1.
71' The free kick will be taken by Ondrej Duda (Verona).
70' Oumar Solet (Udinese) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Giovanni Ayroldi had an easy-decision to make.
69' Substitution. Daniel Mosquera makes his way off the pitch and Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) comes on as his replacement.

69' Ondrej Duda (Verona) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the right post. The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
68' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Udinese comes to nothing.
67' Amin Sarr (Verona) is caught offside!
66' 9:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
65' Arthur Atta (Udinese) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
65' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
61' Substitution. Iker Bravo (Udinese) replaces Martin Payero.
60' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) was quite harsh and Giovanni Ayroldi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
59' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
56' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp links up with Arthur Atta (Udinese), who fires just wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
55' The free kick from long range, taken by Udinese, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
53' Arthur Atta (Udinese) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
52' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Daniele Ghilardi, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
50' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
50' Martin Payero (Udinese) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
49' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
47' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
47' Ondrej Duda (Verona) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) comes off for Kingsley Ehizibue.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Kosta Runjaic gives a chance to Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) and Alexis Sanchez is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Arthur Atta (Udinese) is penalised for holding. Giovanni Ayroldi signals a set piece.
40' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Maduka Okoye intercepts the ball.
35' Tomas Suslov (Verona) takes a short corner kick.
34' Flag goes up against Alexis Sanchez (Udinese) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
31' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) attempts to find Jordan Zemura, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
29' Rough tackle by Sandi Lovric (Udinese). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
26' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle and it's Tomas Suslov (Verona) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
25' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lorenzo Montipo, who smothers the ball.
22' Jordan Zemura pings in a cross towards the edge of the six-yard box. Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) jumps highest but sends his header just over the bar.
20' Tomas Suslov (Verona) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
19' Giovanni Ayroldi shows a yellow card to Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) for his blatant foul.
18' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
17' Daniel Mosquera finds some space and receives a very precise long pass from Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona).
15' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Lorenzo Montipo is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
13' Ondrej Duda (Verona) shows his incredible technical ability by sending the ball into free space and Amin Sarr latches onto his pass.
12' Alexis Sanchez (Udinese) is flagged for offside.
7' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Tomas Suslov (Verona) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
4' Tomas Suslov (Verona) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Amin Sarr, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
3' Amin Sarr (Verona) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
2' One of the players from Udinese times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle. Daniel Mosquera (Verona) commits a foul after dangerous play.
1' Udinese seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has just begun.
Verona will kick-off.
Giovanni Ayroldi will referee today's match.
